sources.name: TxDOT Project Information (data.texas.gov / Socrata, refreshed hourly by TxDOT)
sources.type: API (CORS open; also refreshable live in the browser)
sources.note: Dataset has 9116 rows in all stages; kept projects in pre-construction stages (Planning, Initiate, Execute, PE, PS&E, Ready to Let, Letting, Procurement, Design and Construction) that match drainage keywords or roadway/bridge types likely to carry drainage design.

sources.name: TxDOT Project Tracker, PS&E milestone dates (ArcGIS TxDOT_Projects_Info)
sources.type: API (CORS open); enrichment only, joined by project ID
sources.note: Enrichment only (adds actual PS&E 30/60/100% dates and TxDOT contact where the Tracker has them). Joined to 1287 radar records.

sources.name: TxDOT Projected Contracts List: anticipated A/E/S consultant contracts (xlsx)
sources.type: Snapshot (file download, no CORS)
sources.note: All rows kept (including non-drainage disciplines, flagged as not relevant). FY2027: 24 rows; FY2028: HTTP 404 for https://www.txdot.gov/content/dam/docs/division

sources.name: TxDOT PEPS "Consultants selected for negotiations" (HTML table: PS&E, H&H, bridge design only)
sources.type: Snapshot (HTML scrape of a public page; txdot.gov has no robots.txt)
sources.note: Keeps work types PS&E, H&H and BRGD from fiscal year 2025 onward. The page lists only ID, closing date, wave, work type, service center.

sources.name: TxDOT PEPS consultant information meetings (HTML table)
sources.type: Snapshot (HTML scrape of a public page)
sources.note: Kept meetings whose title mentions PS&E/hydraulics/drainage/bridge design or matches drainage keywords.

sources.name: City of Houston CIP: stormwater and drainage layers (HPW CIPProgramming MapServer)
sources.type: Snapshot (ArcGIS REST; CORS reflects origin)
sources.note: Layers 7, 11, 65, 68 (stormwater/drainage) kept whole; layers 2 and 10 (street/traffic, interagency) kept only when the description matches drainage keywords. Same CIP number+stage across layers is merged. Completed (CP) projects dropped.

sources.name: City of Houston stormwater maintenance (SWMB) project list (FeatureServer)
sources.type: Snapshot (ArcGIS REST)
sources.note: Kept pre-construction and in-progress statuses only (nomination, qualifies, planned, study, screening, in design, NTP pending, in construction, on hold). Completed, cancelled, closed, transferred and archived dropped.

sources.name: HCFCD maintenance project schedule (ArcGIS layer hosted by LJA Engineering; unofficial mirror)
sources.type: Snapshot (ArcGIS REST)
sources.note: Hosted by a consulting firm, not by HCFCD; only FY26 maintenance projects (not the capital/bond program). Completed and cancelled dropped.

sources.name: HCFCD "Current & Past Bid Opportunities" (HTML tables, links to Bonfire)
sources.type: Snapshot (HTML scrape; hcfcd.org robots.txt does not disallow this path)
sources.note: The page lists job number, title and a Bonfire link only: no due dates, no open/closed flag, no location. Links are copied from HCFCD's page; Bonfire answers automated requests with 403 (bot protection), so they were not click-tested.

sources.name: TWDB Flood Infrastructure Fund project list (table hosted by Pape-Dawson Engineers; mirror of TWDB data)
sources.type: Snapshot (ArcGIS REST table, no coordinates)
sources.note: Mirror hosted by a consulting firm. Rows have sponsor, name, estimated cost and FIF type; no stage, date or coordinates.

sources.name: City of Austin Finance Online: Active Solicitations (xlsx export of the public page)
sources.type: Snapshot (xlsx download; public, no login; austintexas.gov has no robots.txt for this host)
sources.note: Every active solicitation Austin lists (all categories). 2 are in the Consultant services focus (RFQS = qualifications-type, or RFP with engineering words). Contact names/emails in the export are not copied. Austin lists open solicitations only; no "upcoming" list was found.

sources.name: City of Austin Contracts dataset (data.austintexas.gov / Socrata 84ih-p28j): active professional-services agreements
sources.type: Snapshot (open-data API, CORS open); awarded work, not solicitations
sources.note: Dataset rows: 625 (152 in category Professional Services, grouped into 28 agreements with their vendor lists). These are AWARDED agreements; the end date can hint at a recompete (inferred). Dataset says contracts are visible only while active, but several end dates are in the past; shown as given.
